tasks.personal-social-wellbeing-t4: Generate Grade 6 Life Skills multiple-choice items on personal and social well-being covering puberty, emotions, HIV and AIDS awareness, community service, and career awareness. Emphasise respectful language about change, supportive responses, facts that challenge stigma, and links between strengths, community roles, and future goals.
tasks.physical-education-t4: Generate Grade 6 Life Skills multiple-choice items on physical education covering team games, fitness circuits, coordination review, recreation, and health. Emphasise combining movement skills in games and stations, fair play, safe participation, self-assessment, and the health benefits of regular physical activity.
tasks.creative-arts-t4: Generate Grade 6 Life Skills multiple-choice items on creative arts covering 3D construction, design planning, dance-drama integration, and final presentation. Emphasise planning a model or sculpture, choosing and joining materials, balance and texture, rehearsal, teamwork, showcase preparation, portfolio evidence, and peer feedback.
tasks.gr6-basic-first-aid-t4: Topic: Basic first aid for Grade 6 Life Skills (CAPS term 4 Personal and Social Well-being). Cover what first aid is and the first steps (stay safe, shout for an adult, call for help: ambulance 10177, or 112 from a cell phone), cuts and bleeding (rinse a small cut with clean water and cover it; press firmly with a clean cloth on bleeding and get an adult; use a cloth and wash hands afterwards), bruises (a wrapped cold pack for a short time), burns and scalds (cool under cool running water for at least 10 minutes, cover loosely, get help if big or deep; never butter, toothpaste or ice), sunburn and its prevention (hat, sunscreen, shade at midday), stings, snake bites (keep the person still and get to a hospital; do not cut or suck) and dog bites, poisoning (tell an adult at once, never make the person vomit, Poisons Information Helpline 0861 555 777), choking (if the person cannot cough, speak or breathe, shout for an adult and call 10177) and when to always get help. Give no medicine names or doses. Write for 11 to 12 year olds in plain words with no graphic detail. Ask scenario and recall questions.
tasks.gr6-food-hygiene-t4: Topic: Food hygiene for Grade 6 Life Skills (CAPS term 4 Personal and Social Well-being). Cover safe and harmful food (fresh, clean and in date versus mouldy, smelly, past its date, raw or half-cooked chicken, swollen tins; food allergies), preparing food safely (wash hands with soap and water for about 20 seconds, wash fruit and vegetables, separate boards for raw meat, cook meat right through, cover cuts), storing food (fridge for milk, meat and leftovers, cover food against flies, closed containers for dry foods, check dates), and food-borne diseases (illness from germs or poisons in food or drink; tummy ache, vomiting, diarrhoea, fever; typhoid and cholera spread through dirty water or food; drink clean water; go to a clinic or doctor if the illness is bad). Write for 11 to 12 year olds in plain words. Ask scenario and recall questions.
tasks.gr6-communicable-diseases-t4: Topic: Communicable diseases for Grade 6 Life Skills (CAPS term 4 Personal and Social Well-being). Cover that a communicable disease passes from person to person and is caused by germs (viruses, bacteria, fungi) spread through the air, touch and dirty food or water, and for each of colds, mumps, chickenpox (viruses), tuberculosis (bacteria, spread through the air by coughing, a cough of more than two weeks is a reason to go to the clinic, treated with medicine from the clinic for many months, people with TB deserve kindness) and athlete's foot (a fungus between the toes), the cause, the signs, how to prevent it and where to find help (a trusted adult, a clinic, a doctor). Give no medicine names or doses. Write for 11 to 12 year olds in plain words. Ask scenario and recall questions.
